stanley_straight_decay — DRIVE lateral op

• Data kinds: none → signal (an op determined by its arguments alone — it takes no image or data input)

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.stanley_straight_decay(e0: 'float', t, *, gain: 'float', speed: 'float', softening: 'float' = 0.0) -> 'np.ndarray' (to call the implementation directly, import drivelateral; drivelateral.stanley_straight_decay(e0: 'float', t, *, gain: 'float', speed: 'float', softening: 'float' = 0.0) -> 'np.ndarray'; from the registry, opsdrive.get("stanley_straight_decay"))

Usage

Closed form of the front-axle lateral offset e(t) under Stanley (unclipped) on a straight path.

> The detailed description below is the original text — the summary and the headings are translated.

ė = −v k e / √(a² + k² e²)、a = k_s + v。F(e) = √(a² + k²e²) − a ln((a + √(a² + k²e²))/(k|e|)) は dF/dt = −v k(一定)。F(e(t)) = F(e₀) − v k t を |e| ∈ (0, |e₀|] の二分法(F は |e| に単調増加)で解く。小さい e では e ≈ e₀' e^{−k t v/a}(指数)、大きい e では |e| がほぼ v t で減る(直線)。

Raises ValueError: k ≤ 0、v ≤ 0、k_s < 0、t < 0。
